claims.text: Urine Ca > 200 to 250 mg/day: ↓the Ca and vitamin D dose;
claims.quote: A urine calcium excretion of over 200 to 250 mg daily should alert clinicians that the calcium and vitamin D dose needs to be reduced.

claims.text: alternative: add HCTZ to ↓urinary Ca excretion.
claims.quote: An alternative strategy is to add hydrochlorothiazide to reduce urinary calcium excretion.
